recipe.title: System Comparison
recipe.purpose: Compare social, political, technical, or philosophical systems by design commitments and tradeoffs.
recipe.groupingLogic: Groups should be systems or system families, separated by governance logic, constraints, values, or operating model.
recipe.contributorRules: Contributors should be tied to system design, advocacy, critique, or canonical articulation.
recipe.generationInstructions: Surface the operating logic of each system and the concrete tradeoffs between systems.
evaluationCriteria: Systems are compared on meaningful axes
